en: Black‑and‑white view of a hillside town. In the foreground stand several large, ornate villas with steep tiled roofs and decorative façades, set behind fences and small trees. Behind them rises a terraced hillside that appears to be used for vineyards or agriculture. At the top center of the hill is a round tower‑like structure, and on the distant right crest of the hill is a church or monastery complex with multiple roofs and a tall spire. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century European spa or vineyard town.
